title: Where Your Name Written as "Good Servant"?
body:
A`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem.
...our Lord, Allah Almighty. Therefore, people have lost their ways and they are following shaytanic ways,
teachings, and trespassings. From shaytanic ways the whole world is coming down, even though technology
just reached its top point and civilization is coming down, down, down. What shall we do? We are trying to do
what makes Allah Almighty happy with us!
Others are following people to fire, as Shaytan runs after youngsters because it is easy to cheat them with
dunya's pleasures. Therefore, keep yourself away from Shaytan and it's traps. (Mawlana Shaykh questions
some guests about their marital status.) Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem. The first command now for young
brothers is marriage; those who are coming to tariqah must keep marriage. Understand? Try to be good ones.
(Inshaa'Allah Sayyidee. We are nothing without you.) Good ones. There are two tablets: on one is written
"Good Servants," on the second is written "Shaytan's Servants." Look where your name is written. You may
reach treasures from dunya, but if your name is written under Shaytan's servants, what is the benefit? Try to
make sure your name is written as "Good Servant", a servant of the Lord, Almighty Allah. Don't leave yourself
to be Shaytan's slave!
